Axiom:
Test structure is fixed: 1. Navigate (`page.goto`). 2. Capture / assert structure via `toMatchAriaSnapshot` on a scoped region. 3. Interact via `getByRole(...)`. 4. Assert the delta via another `toMatchAriaSnapshot` (or focused role-based assertion).
Skipping the first AX assertion turns the test into «click + hope»; without an initial baseline the interaction's delta has nothing to be a delta from.
